subtitle: AUTOINCREMENT, and the HASH-based pattern real ELT code uses

caption: Same experience as T-SQL's IDENTITY — assigns the next value automatically on insert.

code:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE analytics.dim_customer AS
SELECT
    HASH(customer_id) AS customer_key,
    customer_id,
    customer_name
FROM staging.customers_cleaned;
caption: Deterministic, no round trip needed — the same natural key always produces the same key.
